title: CCTVEvent
description: Schema for a structured event logged by Anigma's governance (CCTV) system.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp of when the event occurred.

source_module.description: The module or component that initiated or was affected by the event (e.g., `GovernedMigrationCore`, `HarmoniaCLI`, `AI_Agent`).

action_id.description: Unique ID of the action or proposal associated with this event (e.g., Task ID from ActionProposal).

decision.description: The outcome of the governance evaluation.

governance_layer.description: The governance layer responsible for the decision or primary involvement.

severity.description: The severity level of the event.

details.description: A human-readable description of the event, including context.

required_evidence.description: References to evidence required for decision (e.g., research bundle ID, test report hash).

resulting_debt_task_id.description: If applicable, the ID of a technical debt task created as a result of this event.

metadata.description: Additional structured data relevant to the event (e.g., trust score delta, rule ID).
